source: Binance Spot public data-api.binance.vision /api/v3/klines BTCUSDT; 1h/4h aggregated exclusively from complete UTC 15m blocks

DONCHIAN.confirmation: directed close beyond prior20 range; prior close not beyond range; trend EMA20/50

TREND_ATR.confirmation: EMA50/200 trend and EMA50 slope; directed close crosses EMA20 after previous close on opposite side

EMA_RSI_ADX.confirmation: RSI threshold cross, EMA20/50 direction and close beyond EMA20; +DI/-DI agrees

entry: Signal closed at T; ideal next available 15m open T; fees/slip each side. Additional validation only delays dispatch one 15m bar for ALL candidates; no refitting.
trailing: Lab-only ratchet after each completed strategy-TF bar, effective next 15m open. Chandelier since-entry extremes minus/plus 3*ATR, clamp to closed price, never loosen. TP fixed. No retrospectively applying a new stop to the candle that computed it.
selection: Development only among all eleven candidates (two native baselines and nine new strategy/TF variants): >=30 closed trades, net>0, PF>=1.1, DD<10%, positive >=half complete development months; rank expectancy, then predeclared variant order. Freeze before validation metrics. No substitute winner using validation.
validation_gate: Selected candidate >=20 closed trades, net>0, PF>=1.1, DD<10%, >=half full validation months positive AND latency sensitivity net>0/PF>=1.1. Descriptive gate, not statistical proof.
limitations: Chronological 30% overlaps previously examined history; not pristine blind holdout.
Nine preregistered strategy/timeframe candidates; multiple comparisons, no parameter search.
Crypto Spot OHLC directional SHORT simulation, not actual spot short/borrow or Bybit Futures.
No funding/borrow/market impact; fixed fee/slip are assumptions, not live execution proof.
Risk halt PAUSED remains latched, no automatic resume in research.
Annual history is one cycle, insufficient to prove tail safety.
